_about: Skyscrapers layer, 100 m and taller (decided with the user October 11, 2026: Vancouver's tallest is under 200 m, so the 150 m cut every other city uses would leave a handful). engine/fetch_skyscrapers.py fetches the Wikipedia list; engine/skyscrapers.py builds docs/vancouver/data/skyscrapers.geojson.
wiki: List of tallest buildings in Vancouver

open._rule: A tower listed with this year's date is drawn hollow (under construction) unless marked true here: it must be open for occupancy, not just topped out.
